name: opencode-model-dispatch
description: OpenCode plugin for choosing models when subagents are dispatched.
author: Lauritz

scripts.check:package-types: tsc --noEmit --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --skipLibCheck false dist/index.d.ts
scripts.check:release-package: bun run check:release-version && bun run scripts/check-packaging.ts --require-all-pickers
scripts.test:package: bun run build && bun run check:package-types && bun run scripts/test-installed-package.ts
scripts.test:opencode: bun run build && bun run scripts/test-opencode-server.ts && bun run scripts/test-opencode-server.ts --same-agent-fifo
scripts.test:opencode:same-agent-fifo: bun run build && bun run scripts/test-opencode-server.ts --same-agent-fifo
scripts.test:gui: bun run build:picker && bun run scripts/smoke-native-picker.ts
scripts.test:gui:auto: bun run build:picker && bun run scripts/smoke-native-picker-auto.ts
scripts.release:preflight: bun run check:release-source && bun run check:release-version && bun run check:notices && bun run typecheck && bun run check:coverage && cargo test --manifest-path picker/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked && bun run check:packaging && bun run test:package && bun run check:manual-gate
scripts.release:artifact-preflight: bun run check:notices && bun run check:release-package && bun run test:package
scripts.check:coverage: bun run coverage && bun run scripts/check-coverage.ts
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run check:release-source && bun run check:manual-gate && bun run check:notices && bun run build && bun run check:release-package && bun run test:package
